summary_zh: 一套可安装的 AI 编码代理技能库，提供数千个 SKILL.md 可复用指令，支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等工具；配套 AAS Core 可搜索本地技能目录、由代理选择技能并预览变更计划，另有 CLI、MCP 与插件方式。
audience_zh: 适合使用 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编码代理，并希望按需挑选、审阅和复用技能指令的开发者与团队。

evidence.quote: 2,884+ reusable AI agent skills for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini CLI. AAS Core adds local catalog discovery, agent-owned selection and plan preview. CLI, MCP and plugins.
> **Find reusable instructions for your project, inspect their complete files, and keep an exact skill set you can review and reuse.**

Agentic Awesome Skills is a library of 2,917+ installable `SKILL.md` playbooks for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and other AI coding agents. AAS Core helps Codex or Claude search the complete local catalog, record the skills the agent chooses, and preview a plan you can inspect before chang

**Current release: V20.4.0.** AAS Core supports local catalog inspection, agent-owned selection, stack validation, and plan preview. Apply and recovery remain experimental.
